summary: Iteration 29 — Conditional Pick Upgrades + Auth router extraction + Mobile Chat parity. Backend is solid: 11/11 new auth router tests pass and pick-downgrade engine test passes (1 upgrade test SKIPPED — partner had no R2 pick at test time, test is correct, just lacking seed data). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG FOUND: the actually-rendered trade builder component (GlobalTradeBuilder.jsx) does NOT contain the new '+ Pick upgrade' button or the <PickUpgradeEditor /> mount. The wiring went into a different component (TradeBuilder.tsx) that is not what gets shown when a user clicks roster-trade-btn-{id}. Net effect: end-users cannot reach the new pick-upgrade UI in production. All testids (add-pick-upgrade-btn, pick-upgrade-row-*, pick-upgrades-empty, etc.) exist in the editor component file but are unreachable because the editor is never mounted. Mobile ChatScreen.js (529 lines) verified via static analysis — channels, DMs, messages, @mention, mute long-press, create/delete channel are all present.

minor.issue: test_pick_upgrade_applies_when_championship_unlocks SKIPS in current league state because partner team has no remaining 2nd-round pick (likely consumed by prior iterations of this same test, since the test only restores round/year of the upgraded pick — it does not restore current_team_id). Suggest test should also reset current_team_id or pick a fresh pick query. Engine itself is verified by the downgrade test, which passes.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing '+ Pick upgrade' button and <PickUpgradeEditor /> mount. File /app/frontend/src/lovable/components/trade/GlobalTradeBuilder.jsx lines 338-356 only renders '+ Player stat' and '+ Team result' buttons + <TradeConditionsEditor />. The new pick-upgrade button was added to the WRONG component (TradeBuilder.tsx lines 612-628, which is not what mounts when the user clicks roster-trade-btn-{id}). Verified live: opened trade builder from /team page, scanned all data-testids on the page — add-pick-upgrade-btn does NOT appear; only tb-add-player-condition and tb-add-team-condition appear. End-user can never reach the new editor.

integration_issues.issue: Because the editor is unreachable, window.__getPickUpgrades() always returns empty array, so the /api/trades and /api/trades/multi payloads will never include pick_upgrades from real user flow. Backend correctly receives them when sent (pytest proves it), but no UI path exists.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add the '+ Pick upgrade' button and <PickUpgradeEditor /> mount to /app/frontend/src/lovable/components/trade/GlobalTradeBuilder.jsx (around lines 342-355, alongside the existing '+ Player stat' / '+ Team result' buttons). Use the same wiring as TradeBuilder.tsx lines 612-628: onClick={() => window.__addPickUpgrade?.()} with data-testid='add-pick-upgrade-btn', and mount <PickUpgradeEditor /> right after <TradeConditionsEditor />. Without this, the entire pick-upgrade feature is unreachable from the UI.
MINOR: Patch test_pick_upgrade_applies_when_championship_unlocks teardown to also restore pick.current_team_id (or pre-create a fresh R2 pick) so the test is fully idempotent across runs.
OPTIONAL: Confirm whether TradeBuilder.tsx is dead code now that GlobalTradeBuilder.jsx is the canonical component — if so, delete it to prevent future double-wiring mistakes.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG (critical): /app/frontend/src/lovable/components/trade/GlobalTradeBuilder.jsx is the canonical rendered Trade Builder (testid='global-trade-builder', confirmed via DOM probe), but the new pick-upgrade integration was added to /app/frontend/src/lovable/components/trade/TradeBuilder.tsx — a separate, unmounted .tsx component. Two sibling 'TradeBuilder' files invite exactly this kind of mistake. Recommend consolidation.

Backend auth router (/app/backend/routes/auth.py) is well-structured: extracted cleanly via setup(deps) injection, all 7 endpoints behave identically to pre-extraction. Cookie + Bearer dual-auth on /refresh works correctly. Brute-force lockout, dup-email rejection, bogus-token 401 all confirmed.

Backend pick-upgrade engine (server.py _apply_pick_upgrades) correctly handles: idempotency (applied_at gates re-eval), bidirectional rounds (downgrade R1→R3 verified live), audit_log row written, draft_picks.trade_history pushed, trade.pick_upgrades[i].applied_at set. Award-toggle re-eval hook returns pick_upgrades_applied count.

Mobile ChatScreen.js (529 LOC) is at the upper end of the >700-line file-size guideline but still acceptable. Implements channels list, DMs list, message send, @mention popup, mute (whitelisted durations), create/delete channel with permission gating via league.commissioner_id + co_commissioners. Component shape and imports are valid React Native; module resolves cleanly.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_router.py — NEW, 11 pytest cases covering all 7 auth router endpoints (login, /me, refresh via Bearer + cookie, register success + dup-email, logout, forgot-password, reset-password).

success_rate.backend: 100% — 12/12 executed tests pass (1 skip-by-environment, not a failure). Auth router 11/11, pick-upgrade engine 1/1 executed.
success_rate.frontend: 0% on the new pick-upgrade UX — the entry-point button is missing from the rendered component, so no user-facing flow exists. Other parts of the trade builder (asset add, conditions, send) are unaffected and continue to work.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE — Two sibling Trade Builder components exist in the same folder: /app/frontend/src/lovable/components/trade/TradeBuilder.tsx (typed, not mounted in current routes) and /app/frontend/src/lovable/components/trade/GlobalTradeBuilder.jsx (untyped, mounted via AppLayout + TradeBuilderContext, this is what users see). The pick-upgrade feature work was added to TradeBuilder.tsx instead of GlobalTradeBuilder.jsx. STEPS TO REPRODUCE: 1) login as chriszarek 2) /team 3) click any [data-testid^='roster-trade-btn-'] 4) Trade Builder panel opens at bottom-right with 'Conditional Triggers' section showing only '+ Player stat' and '+ Team result' — no '+ Pick upgrade'. MITIGATION: copy the JSX block from /app/frontend/src/lovable/components/trade/TradeBuilder.tsx lines 612-628 (button + editor mount) into /app/frontend/src/lovable/components/trade/GlobalTradeBuilder.jsx around line 352 (after the '+ Team result' button) and after line 355 (after <TradeConditionsEditor />).
